<h1 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">pytest-asyncio</h1>

</a>
<p dir="auto">
<a href="https://pytest-asyncio.readthedocs.io/en/stable/" rel="nofollow">pytest-asyncio</a>
 is a 
<a href="https://docs.pytest.org/en/latest/contents.html" rel="nofollow">pytest</a>
 plugin. It facilitates testing of code that uses the 
<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/asyncio.html" rel="nofollow">asyncio</a>
 library.
</p>
<p dir="auto">
Specifically, pytest-asyncio provides support for coroutines as test functions. This allows users to 
<em>await</em>
 code inside their tests. For example, the following code is executed as a test item by pytest:
</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-python notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto">
<pre><span class="pl-en">
@
<span class="pl-s1">pytest</span>
.
<span class="pl-c1">mark</span>
.
<span class="pl-c1">asyncio</span>
</span>
<span class="pl-k">async</span> <span class="pl-k">def</span> <span class="pl-en">test_some_asyncio_code</span>
():
    
<span class="pl-s1">res</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-k">await</span> <span class="pl-s1">library</span>
.
<span class="pl-c1">do_something</span>
()
    
<span class="pl-k">assert</span> <span class="pl-s">b"expected result"</span> <span class="pl-c1">==</span> <span class="pl-s1">res</span>
</pre>
<div class="zeroclipboard-container">

async def test_some_asyncio_code():
    res = await library.do_something()
    assert b"expected result" == res" tabindex="0" role="button">

<p dir="auto">
More details can be found in the 
<a href="https://pytest-asyncio.readthedocs.io/en/stable/" rel="nofollow">documentation</a>
.
</p>
<p dir="auto">
Note that test classes subclassing the standard 
<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/unittest.html" rel="nofollow">unittest</a>
 library are not supported. Users
are advised to use 
<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/library/unittest.html#unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase" rel="nofollow">unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase</a>

or an async framework such as 
<a href="https://asynctest.readthedocs.io/en/latest" rel="nofollow">asynctest</a>
.
</p>
<p dir="auto">
pytest-asyncio is available under the

.
</p>
